name: MIRO
summary: MIRO is Midea's industrial humanoid development platform. Its reported application work includes factory inspection, patrol and sheet-metal feeding, connecting perception and mobile operation with production tasks. Midea uses these manufacturing settings to explore embodied-intelligence deployment, with the robot's configuration and behavior developed around the particular factory workflow.
